summary.intent: Fix two bugs in the release-gate.yml CI workflow where: (1) the Web E2E check was incorrectly gating on the overall CI E2E orchestrator result instead of the specific Web E2E job, and (2) the Desktop E2E check was searching for standalone desktop-e2e.yml workflow runs that don't exist when triggered via workflow_call.
summary.outcome: Both issues were fixed and a PR was created (FSM1/cipher-box#409). A follow-up commit addressed CodeRabbit review comments distinguishing 'job ran and failed' from 'job was skipped' in both the Web E2E and Desktop E2E fallback logic.

repo: desktop-e2e.yml and web-e2e.yml are called via workflow_call from ci-e2e.yml — they do NOT create separate workflow runs; their jobs appear inside the ci-e2e.yml run
The canonical way to manually unblock the release gate is to dispatch ci-e2e.yml on main — standalone web-e2e.yml or desktop-e2e.yml dispatches are NOT picked up by the gate checks
release-gate.yml checks for E2E jobs by name ('Web E2E', 'Desktop E2E') within the ci-e2e.yml orchestrator run, not by searching for child workflow runs

code.finding: Original Web E2E check had an early-exit guard on E2E_CONCLUSION (overall orchestrator result) — if Desktop E2E failed, Web E2E was reported as failed even when its own job passed
Original Desktop E2E check searched for standalone desktop-e2e.yml workflow runs, which never exist when triggered via workflow_call — rewritten to check jobs within ci-e2e.yml runs instead
After PR review: fallback logic could not distinguish 'job ran and failed' from 'job was skipped', causing premature fallback to older runs; fixed in both Web and Desktop E2E sections

workflow: When a reusable workflow is called via workflow_call, its jobs are nested inside the caller's run — searching for the child workflow's run by filename will always return empty
CodeRabbit caught a skip-vs-fail ambiguity bug in the fallback logic that wasn't obvious from the original bug report

friction: User interrupted the initial fix attempt mid-stream to ask about manual dispatch coverage before the desktop rewrite was complete
The fallback search logic had a secondary bug (skip vs fail ambiguity) that required a second commit after PR review
open_items: Standalone web-e2e.yml and desktop-e2e.yml dispatches are not recognized by the release gate — user explicitly deferred adding fallback support for those
No local tests were run (pnpm typecheck / pnpm test) — the workflow file changes weren't validated beyond visual inspection before pushing
